Have you ever wondered how a group of thieves stole more than $40 million from a bank vault without ever firing a single shot? In this video, we uncover the true story of the 1976 Société Générale bank heist in Nice, France, where Albert Spaggiari and his team spent months tunneling through the city’s sewers before breaking into the bank’s vault through its concrete walls. Stay to the end to discover exactly how the tunnel was built, how the robbery was carried out, and why it became known as one of the greatest bank heists in history.
